stem: What was the most significant result of the 1957 launch of Sputnik?

options.label: F
options.text: U.S. military troops were deployed to Korea.

options.label: G
options.text: The United States ended its involvement in the Vietnam War.

options.label: H
options.text: A space race between the United States and the Soviet Union began.

options.label: J
options.text: The U.S. government implemented the Marshall Plan.
